# oneway_anova: x
groups = [g['x'].drop_nulls().to_numpy() for _, g in df.group_by('g3')]
f, p = stats.f_oneway(*groups)

# mann_whitney: x
groups_raw = df['g2'].drop_nulls().unique().sort().to_list()
mask = df['x'].is_not_null() & df['g2'].is_not_null()
g1 = df.filter(mask & (pl.col('g2') == groups_raw[0]))['x'].to_numpy()
g2 = df.filter(mask & (pl.col('g2') == groups_raw[1]))['x'].to_numpy()
u, p = stats.mannwhitneyu(g1, g2, alternative='two-sided')

# kruskal_wallis: x
groups = [g['x'].drop_nulls().to_numpy() for _, g in df.group_by('g3')]

# pearson_correlation: y

# spearman_correlation: y
pair = df.select(['y', 'x']).drop_nulls()

# chi_square: cat
ct = df.group_by(['g2','cat']).len().pivot(values='len', index='g2', columns='cat').fill_null(0)
